properties.description: Three layers. (1) cues.rs unit tests: a batch cue is withheld after its offer until the session acts on it; a batch ends after BATCH_CALLS of the session's calls or BATCH_SECS; only BATCH_CUES are withheld (set_decision_status never) and the --call door's calls are one session; due() reads the set the call was served with; the withheld hint names no call. usage.rs: read_tail returns the last whole lines. (2) tests/a_batch_cue_is_offered_once_per_batch.rs (in_memory program): handler replies under cues::with_withheld. (3) tools/test_feedback_is_a_computed_tally.py section 7, over stdio against the real binary and its ledger: three add_requirement writes, the first offers detect_gaps and loop_status and the next two carry the withheld hint; the ledger records loop_hint/detect_gaps once; after detect_gaps it is offered again; replace_text keeps set_decision_status and withholds loop_status; add_change_event touching an Artifact carries next_step naming set_artifact_checksums, counted as next_step/set_artifact_checksums, and one touching only a requirement carries none.
